title: The Lorry Theory Test: Format & Pass Marks
whatItIs: Driver CPC part 1 is 2 tests: 100 multiple-choice questions and a hazard perception test of 19 video clips. Book them separately; pass both within 2 years of each other.
keyFacts: Multiple choice: 100 questions in 1 hour 55 minutes. The pass mark is 85 out of 100.
You can flag questions, go back and change any answer, and finish early once all are answered.
Hazard perception: 19 clips, each with at least one developing hazard. One clip has 2.
You score up to 5 points for each developing hazard. The pass mark is 67 out of 100.
The questions are based on The Highway Code, Know your traffic signs and the DVSA guide to driving goods vehicles.
Your theory certificate is valid for 2 years from when you passed the first part.

items.label: Hazard perception
items.note: Up to 5 points per developing hazard

a.label: Developing hazard
points: Something that would make you act, like changing speed or direction
e.g. a parked car signals right and starts to move away

b.label: Not a developing hazard
points: Something you can see that wouldn't make you take action
e.g. a car parked at the side of the road, doing nothing

onTheTest.question: In the hazard perception part of the lorry theory test, what is the most you can score for one developing hazard?
onTheTest.why: You can score up to 5 points for each developing hazard. To get a high score, click as soon as you see the hazard starting to develop.

onTheTest.question: How long do you have to answer the multiple-choice questions in the lorry theory test?
onTheTest.why: You have 1 hour and 55 minutes to answer 100 multiple-choice questions. The pass mark is 85 out of 100.

traps: The pass marks differ: 85 out of 100 for multiple choice, 67 out of 100 for hazard perception.
Clicking all the time or in a pattern scores nothing for that clip. Wrong clicks alone lose no points.
You get one attempt at each clip: you can't review or change your responses.
Failed? Book again straight away, but you can't take the test for another 3 clear working days.
